title: Tell, ask someone to do: kể lại lời nhờ, lời khuyên
summary: Kể lại mệnh lệnh, lời nhờ, lời khuyên, lời hứa: tell, ask, advise, remind + người + to V, và promise, offer, refuse + to V.

dialogue.en: She [[told me to rest]] for a few days.
dialogue.vi: Bác sĩ bảo mình nghỉ ngơi vài ngày.

dialogue.en: Yes, and she [[advised me not to drink]] coffee.
dialogue.vi: Có, và bác sĩ khuyên mình đừng uống cà phê.
Thôi xong. Bạn mê cà phê mà!

dialogue.en: I know. My wife [[promised to hide]] all the coffee!
dialogue.vi: Biết vậy. Vợ mình hứa sẽ giấu hết cà phê đi rồi!

sections.heading: Tell, ask, advise, remind + người + to V
sections.rule: Kể lại **mệnh lệnh, lời nhờ, lời khuyên, lời nhắc**: **động từ + người + to V**. Phủ định: **not to V**.

formula.text: S + [told / asked / advised / reminded] + người + [to V]

body: **tell** = ra lệnh, bảo; **ask** = nhờ, xin; **advise** = khuyên; **remind** = nhắc. Chọn động từ cho đúng ý thì không cần lùi thì gì cả.

head: Lời nói trực tiếp
Lời kể lại
rows: He told me to close the door.
She asked me to help her.
The doctor advised me to rest.
Mum reminded me not to forget my keys.

examples.en: The teacher [[told us to be]] quiet.
examples.vi: Cô giáo bảo chúng tôi giữ trật tự.
examples.why: Mệnh lệnh → told + us + to be.

examples.en: I [[asked her to send]] me the file.
examples.vi: Tôi nhờ cô ấy gửi tài liệu cho tôi.
examples.why: Lời nhờ → asked + her + to send.

examples.vi: Anh ấy bảo tôi đừng lo.

check.prompt: "Please wait here." → She asked me ___ there.

sections.heading: Promise, offer, refuse, agree + to V
sections.rule: Kể lại **lời hứa, lời đề nghị giúp, lời từ chối, sự đồng ý**: **promise / offer / refuse / agree + to V** (không có người ở giữa).

examples.en: "I'll call you tonight." → He [[promised to call]] me.
examples.vi: Anh ấy hứa sẽ gọi cho tôi.

examples.en: "Shall I carry your bag?" → She [[offered to carry]] my bag.
examples.vi: Cô ấy ngỏ ý xách túi giúp tôi.
examples.why: Đề nghị giúp → offered + to V.

examples.en: "No, I won't pay." → He [[refused to pay]].
examples.vi: Anh ta từ chối trả tiền.

check.prompt: "OK, I'll help you." → She agreed ___ me.

sections.heading: Suggest: không dùng người + to V
sections.rule: **suggest** không theo mẫu *suggest someone to*. Dùng **suggest + V-ing** hoặc **suggest (that) + câu**.

examples.en: "Let's take a taxi." → He [[suggested taking]] a taxi.
examples.vi: Anh ấy gợi ý đi taxi.
Cô ấy gợi ý chúng tôi đi sớm.

options: He suggested me to go home.
check.explain: Suggest + V-ing, không dùng suggest me to.

mistakes.wrong: She told me close the window.
mistakes.right: She told me to close the window.

mistakes.wrong: He told me don't be late.
mistakes.right: He told me not to be late.

mistakes.why: Say không dùng với người + to V; dùng tell.

mistakes.wrong: He suggested me to see a doctor.
mistakes.right: He suggested that I see a doctor.

mistakes.wrong: My friend promised me to come.
mistakes.why: Promise + to V (thường không có người ở giữa).

exercises.prompt: My mother told me ___ my room.
He offered ___ me to the airport.

options: She told me not to touch it.
She told me don't touch it.
She said me not to touch it.

exercises.prompt: "Please call me later." → He asked me ___ him later.
answers: to call

exercises.prompt: "Don't park here." → The guard told us ___ there.
answers: not to park

exercises.prompt: "I'll pay you back next week." → She promised ___ me back the next week.
answers: to pay

exercises.prompt: "Let's eat out tonight." → He suggested ___ out that night.
answers: eating

exercises.prompt: "Remember to lock the door." → She ___ me to lock the door.
answers: reminded

exercises.vi: Sếp bảo tôi gửi email cho khách hàng.
Anh ấy từ chối trả lời câu hỏi.

exercises.sentence: The teacher told us don't use our phones.
answers: The teacher told us not to use our phones.

exercises.sentence: She asked me help her with the boxes.
answers: She asked me to help her with the boxes.

exercises.sentence: He suggested me to try the new restaurant.
answers: He suggested trying the new restaurant.

exercises.vi: Bác sĩ khuyên tôi nên ngủ nhiều hơn.
answers: The doctor advised me to sleep more.
The doctor advised me to get more sleep.
My doctor advised me to sleep more.
My doctor advised me to get more sleep.
The doctor told me to sleep more.
The doctor told me to get more sleep.

exercises.vi: Mẹ nhắc tôi đừng quên mang ô.
answers: My mother reminded me not to forget my umbrella.
My mom reminded me not to forget my umbrella.
Mum reminded me not to forget my umbrella.
My mother reminded me to take my umbrella.
My mom reminded me to take my umbrella.
My mother reminded me to bring my umbrella.
My mom reminded me to bring my umbrella.
My mother reminded me not to forget the umbrella.
My mom reminded me not to forget the umbrella.
